decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling an infinite life combo using cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Chord of Calling, and Return to the Ranks. This is supported by cards like Razorverge Thicket and Temple Garden for mana acceleration and consistency. The creatures in the deck provide protection and support for the combo, with Selfless Savior and Wildgrowth Walker helping to stay alive while setting up the combo. The goal is to gain an overwhelming amount of life using Aetherflux Reservoir and win the game in a single turn.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful synergy between Amalia Benavides Aguirre and other creatures to generate life gain and board presence. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company, the deck can efficiently search for and play key creatures to advance its combo strategy. The inclusion of Aetherflux Reservoir as a win condition adds a unique twist to the traditional life gain archetype. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through a combination of creature abilities and life gain effects to secure victory.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of life gain through creatures like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper while building a board presence with cards like Voice of Resurgence and Skyclave Apparition. The key strategy involves using Amalia Benavides Aguirre as a combo piece with cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company to search for key pieces like Aetherflux Reservoir. By gaining a high amount of life, the deck can use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent, potentially securing a win in one turn.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play Arclight Phoenix while using spells like Sleight of Hand, Lightning Axe, and Fiery Impulse to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also focuses on card draw and manipulation to consistently bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, allowing for a fast and relentless assault on the opponent. The inclusion of Ashiok, Dream Render helps to exile opponents' graveyard cards, further enhancing the deck's ability to control the game and dominate with its aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards, especially Arclight Phoenix, and then using spells to bring them back into play for massive damage. The deck includes a mix of cheap cantrips and removal spells to dig through the deck, disrupt the opponent, and control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures, taking advantage of the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard and hit hard. It aims to be fast-paced and aggressive, putting pressure on the opponent early and often.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells and fuel the recursion of Arclight Phoenix. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, using cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster to enable the Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck also includes card draw and control elements to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck is focused on leveraging the powerful recursion ability of Arclight Phoenix to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and play them for free using spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe. The deck also includes draw spells like Opt, Consider, and Treasure Cruise to help find the Phoenixes and fuel their graveyard recursion. Additionally, the deck has disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower to help control the game while attacking with flyers like Picklock Prankster. Overall, it aims to be a fast and aggressive deck that can maintain card advantage and tempo to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play creatures like Tenth District Legionnaire, Favored Hoplite, and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage to the opponent swiftly. The deck includes combat tricks such as Gods Willing and Defiant Strike to protect your creatures and pump them up for more damage. The inclusion of cards like Dreadhorde Arcanist allows for card advantage and repeatable spells, while Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a companion to provide extra mana and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and combat tricks.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of spells and creatures to quickly and creatively disrupt your opponent's strategy while building your own board presence. By utilizing cards like Volcanic Spite, Vaultborn Tyrant, and Indomitable Creativity, you can generate powerful and unexpected plays that can catch your opponent off guard. With a mix of control spells like Negate and memory Deluge to protect your combo pieces, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a mix of aggression and ingenuity.

The primary focus of this deck is to capitalize on the interaction between cards that allow for powerful spells to be cast, such as Magma Opus and Indomitable Creativity, and cards that benefit from the casting of those spells, like Torrential Gearhulk and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. By combining these elements with additional support spells and lands that facilitate the mana base, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning combination that can overwhelm opponents with its explosive creativity and combo potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Raffine's Informant and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for additional support and control. Bitter Triumph and Grisly Salvage provide card advantage and graveyard manipulation, while Duress and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure smooth mana production. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and dominate the game with its powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field as a key piece in a combo strategy. By using cards like Pore Over the Pages, Dark Petition, and Hidden Strings to manipulate mana, the goal is to quickly build up resources and cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. Thespian's Stage and Bala Ged Recovery help to find and reuse key pieces, while Strict Proctor and Archdruid's Charm provide disruptive elements to control the game. The deck aims to set up a strong board state and overwhelm the opponent with high-impact spells.

The deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards to gain card advantage and control the game. It includes a variety of powerful multicolored cards to maximize Niv-Mizzet's potential, along with support cards like Lightning Helix and Vanishing Verse for removal and disruption. The main win conditions include Omnath, Locus of Creation and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, with additional threats like Valki, God of Lies and Krenko's Buzzcrusher. The mana base is set up to support the deck's multicolored spells, with a mix of shock lands, check lands, triomes, and fetch lands.

This deck focuses on utilizing a diverse range of multicolored cards, including powerful creatures and spells, to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece of the deck, the goal is to efficiently cast spells of different colors and generate additional value through card advantage. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in accessing key cards from the deck, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control elements and powerful threats.

The deck aims to control the game through a combination of powerful spells and versatile creatures, with Niv-Mizzet Reborn at the center. By using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bring to Light, the deck can draw cards, remove threats, and search for answers as needed. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for a more consistent and resilient gameplay. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements, while key cards like Lightning Helix and Vanishing Verse provide additional removal and disruption options. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by utilizing creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to deal damage quickly. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support by enabling the deck's creatures and providing a way to gain life. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells while utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Invoke Despair to maintain control of the battlefield.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent through efficient creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Archfiend of the Dross offers additional ways to close out the game. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain control throughout the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It aims to apply pressure early in the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy with Thoughtseize, Duress, and Fatal Push. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord helps to pump up your creatures and provide additional utility. Mutavault and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for additional creature tokens to be generated, while Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester deal consistent damage. The deck's goal is to maintain a steady stream of attackers and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive red creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The key concept is to maintain pressure on the opponent with cheap, efficient creatures and spells, while also utilizing the Companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. By consistently applying pressure and using burn spells to finish off the opponent, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around maximizing damage output and efficiency to secure victories.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to outvalue the opponent by disrupting their game plan and maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of Lutri, the Spellchaser as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. The emphasis is on controlling the board state and protecting key threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon while setting up for a win condition with cards like Torrential Gearhulk and Brazen Borrower. This deck excels at outmaneuvering opponents and establishing a dominant position in the game.

The deck focuses on control through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to stall the game with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Strict Proctor, while controlling the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Portable Hole. Memory Deluge and Meticulous Archive provide card advantage, while Discontinuity can disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck is designed to outvalue opponents and grind them out of resources, ultimately winning the game through a combination of incremental advantage and powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is consistent and flexible, allowing for smooth gameplay.

This UW Control deck focuses on slowing down the opponent's game plan, disrupting their plays, and controlling the board with counterspells and removal spells. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage through cards like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also utilizes cards like Strict Proctor and Tale's End to disrupt the opponent's key plays, while also having win conditions in the form of Shark Typhoon and March of Otherworldly Light. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and support the deck's control strategy.
